line: Checked November 19, 2026: 196,736 checks hold this plate's values and sentences to the study's spectra and the paper, its electrode positions to the 10-20 rules on an idealized head, and its colors to 3:1 contrast with the page for the two end inks and to a scale that, at 20 sampled levels a side, moves steadily away from the neutral ink with near-equal lightness on both sides, and 0 failed.

groups.name: every value in the plate's data equals its row in results/study/spectra.csv
the numbers the paper prints (paper/numbers.tex) equal the plate's, rounded as the paper does
C3, Cz, and C4 sit at their 10-20 positions, and the views keep the subject's left on the left
every state the plate can show reads its numbers straight from the data, at a measured frequency
every readout and sentence the plate can show matches its numbers (all variants, all frequencies, 5,000 random states)
the notes under the plate: the intervals caveat, with its addition for few subjects, how the average channel was made, and the keyboard hint
the diverging scale's inks read on the day page and the night board, apart from the accent
